entities.name: Anna Fárová
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Anna Fárová was a Czech-French art historian who specialized and catalogued Czech and Czechoslovak photographers, including František Drtikol and Josef Sudek. She was one of the pioneers of writing on history of photography. Her publishing activities helped to establish photography, as an art discipline within the country.
